usage: 釣魚 is a common everyday noun for the activity of fishing, and it can also be used as a hobby word in casual speech.
It often appears with verbs like 去 or 玩, for example in phrases like 去釣魚 or 玩釣魚, when talking about going out to fish.
The word is neutral and natural in spoken Cantonese, suitable for both hobby talk and real-life outdoor activities.
When you want to say someone is doing this activity regularly, you can add time words or place words before it, such as at the seaside, in a river, or on the weekend.
